title: ChatPromptModule
description: A versioned chat prompt module. Every conversational turn resolves one of these (a taskType pinned to a frozen version) plus its declared output schema, so a chat answer is a contract rather than an ad-hoc prompt. A chat module's output schema must require the citations envelope (ADR-0023) - registry.chat.prompt_modules.check_module_contract refuses a module whose schema does not. See registry/chat/README.md for the full contract.

taskType.description: Kebab-case task identifier; the registry key a runtime resolves on.

version.description: Version label (v1, v2, ...). A published (taskType, version) is immutable.

description.description: What this module is for and when a caller should use it.

modelTierHint.description: Cheapest model tier that can do the task: low = flash/LOW, med = balanced, high = pro/HIGH. Consumed by the model gateway for routing.

status.description: Lifecycle state. Only 'published' versions resolve at runtime.

groundingPolicy.description: What the module does with grounding. 'require-citations' answers and cites (and refuses when it cannot ground); 'refuse-without-citations' states the refusal and its reason code and answers nothing; 'answer-without-citations' is expressible in the policy space but no published module may use it - a candidate version carrying it regresses the grounded fixture case, and registry.chat.regression refuses the promotion by name.

parameters.description: Optional sampling parameters the gateway should use for this module.

bodyRefs.description: Named pointers (relative to the modules/ directory) to the frozen prompt bodies. At least one part is required; system and user are the conventional parts.

outputSchema.description: Reference (relative path from the module file's directory) to the JSON Schema the model output must satisfy. It must require the citations envelope.
